subject: AWS Marketplace: catalog readiness, procurement checklist & AMI naming
content:
Message 1
--------
From: Alice Smith <alice@acme-analytics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Aug 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace go-live checklist and AMI naming

Hi Jonas,

We're preparing to go live with the Redwood listing on our side and want to confirm a few items before we push the catalog entry to our procurement system: 

- Final product page copy: any last-minute changes we should be aware of?
- AMI naming convention: we need the exact AMI name and seller ID for procurement records.
- Billing SKU and pricing footnotes: procurement needs the clause about metering and credits.
- Evidence for security claims (SOC2, logging, retention): procurement will pull these into the vendor dossier.

Can you send the consolidated artifacts and a short timeframe for when the marketplace tile will be public? We're hoping to align the internal demo and procurement approval next week.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Smith
Head of Cloud Procurement, Acme Analytics

---

Message 2
--------
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Alice Smith <alice@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Aug 2028 10:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace go-live checklist and AMI naming

Hi Alice — great to hear you're moving this forward. Quick answers below and I'm attaching the current product page PDF for your review.

1) Product page copy: attached product-page-draft-v2.pdf. We made a minor tweak to the hero line to clarify pricing triggers (no functional changes). If you want a different tone for procurement, we can supply a stripped-down technical summary.

2) AMI naming / seller ID: the AMI is published under AMI name: redwood-inference-rt-1.0-202808, Seller ID: rdwd-5502. We will confirm AMI IDs in the marketplace UI once the tile is live.

3) Billing SKU & footnotes: see pricing-footnotes.md attached. Primary note: usage metering is per inference-second with a minimal billing granularity of 1 second; credits apply on a monthly reconciliation.

4) Security evidence: Kimberly, looping you in to confirm the evidence bundle (SOC2, logging retention, KMS integration notes) and whether we should include the evidence-matrix.xlsx in the procurement dossier.

Next steps: we'll aim to publish the tile to the AWS catalog by end of day Friday (2028-08-18) pending final sign-off. If that timeline works, can you confirm an internal procurement window for the week of Aug 21?

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
[attachment: product-page-draft-v2.pdf (pdf)]

---

Message 3 (internal thread)
-------------------------
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Aug 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace go-live checklist and AMI naming

Jonas — quick internal notes before we send the finalized package: 

- Evidence matrix: attaching evidence-matrix.xlsx. It contains links to our SOC2 report, encryption KMS diagram, retention policy excerpt, and audit log export examples. Procurement will want the SOC2 cover page + test matrices.
- AMI visibility: confirm the AMI has been tagged with the seller ID and region us-west-2. I'll run a quick audit and report any mismatches.
- Pricing footnote wording: change the line that currently reads "monthly reconciliation" to "monthly invoice reconciliation; credits applied within the following billing cycle." That prevents confusion for their accounting team.
- Public tile notes: include a small section in the page copy that lists supported runtimes and max sequence length (helps SRE when they validate entitlement). Add that as a short bulleted list under "Technical specs."

If we're good on the above I can produce a procurement-ready ZIP (product page + evidence excerpts + AMI audit) by EOD.

Kimberly Park
Marketplace Programs Lead — Redwood Inference
[attachment: evidence-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)]

---

Message 4
--------
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Alice Smith <alice@acme-analytics.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Aug 2028 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Consolidated go-live package and next steps

Hi Alice / Procurement team,

Thanks for the ping. Per Kimberly's audit we've updated the pricing footnote language and compiled a procurement-ready ZIP with the key artifacts. Attached are:

- product-page-final.pdf (copy updated with the technical specs bulleted list)
- evidence-bundle.zip (SOC2 cover page, KMS diagram, retention excerpt)
- ami-naming-guidelines.docx (explicit AMI name conventions and seller ID mapping)
- pricing-footnotes.md (finalized language)

Quick summary of the items you asked for:
- AMI: redwood-inference-rt-1.0-202808 (seller ID rdwd-5502). Published to us-west-2 and tagged.
- Billing: meter = inference-second; minimal billing granularity = 1s; credits applied during next billing cycle.
- Security evidence: SOC2 cover + test matrix included in evidence-bundle.zip.

Links: HubSpot record for this opportunity: https://hubspot.company/contacts/ACME-12345
Procurement packet (GDrive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleProductAssets
DocuSign (when ready): https://www.docusign.net/prepare/ACME-2028-045

Action items for you:
1) Can procurement confirm they have the SOC2 cover page + KMS diagram that meets vendor onboarding?
2) Please confirm a target date for the purchase order; if PO arrives before Friday we'll proceed with the tile publish on the AWS Marketplace.

Proposed demo: Thu Aug 24, 10:00 AM PT — 20 minute technical walkthrough + Q&A. I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
[attachment: product-page-final.pdf (pdf)] [attachment: evidence-bundle.zip (zip)] [attachment: ami-naming-guidelines.docx (docx)] [attachment: pricing-footnotes.md (md)]

--------

Date: Thu, 16 Aug 2028 15:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated go-live package and next steps

Jonas / Kimberly — thanks for the thorough package. Procurement confirmed the SOC2 cover page + KMS diagram meet our baseline. We're aiming to issue a PO by Tuesday Aug 22.

Please go ahead and schedule the demo for Thu Aug 24 at 10:00 AM PT. We'll have the SRE and procurement lead on the call.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Alice Smith
Head of Cloud Procurement, Acme Analytics
